items.name: Message Type
items.comment: This Data Item allows for a more convenient handling of the messages at the receiver side by further defining the type of transaction.

items.name: Data Source Identifier
items.comment: Identification of the system from which the data are received.

data_fields.name: MSG_INDEX
data_fields.comment: Message Sequence Identifier (video record cyclic counter)

items.name: Video Summary
items.comment: Contains an ASCII string (free text to define stream meta data).

data_fields.name: Video Summary
data_fields.comment: ASCII characters, REP counts only the characters

items.name: Video Header Nano
items.comment: Defines a group of video cells corresponding to a video radial: all cells have the same size in azimuth and range and are consecutive in range.

data_fields.name: START_AZ
data_fields.comment: Start azimuth of the cells group, deg

data_fields.name: END_AZ
data_fields.comment: End azimuth of the cells group, deg

data_fields.name: START_RG
data_fields.comment: Starting range of the cells group, expressed in number of cells. 0 is the radar location without any bias.

items.name: Video Header Femto
items.comment: Defines a group of video cells corresponding to a video radial: all cells have the same size in azimuth and range and are consecutive in range.

data_fields.name: START_AZ
data_fields.comment: Start azimuth of the cells group, deg

data_fields.name: END_AZ
data_fields.comment: End azimuth of the cells group, deg

data_fields.name: START_RG
data_fields.comment: Starting range of the cells group, expressed in number of cells. 0 is the radar location without any bias.

items.name: Video Cells Resolution & Data Compression Indicator
items.comment: This Data Item defines the bit resolution used in the coding of the video signal amplitude in all cells of the video group as well as an indicator whether data compression has been applied.

items.name: C
items.comment:
Data Compression Indicator
0 No compression applied
1 Compression applied

items.name: RES
items.comment:
Bit resolution used for the coding of the amplitude of the video signal in every cell of a video group
1 Monobit Resolution (1 bit)
2 Low Resolution (2 bits)
3 Medium Resolution (4 bits)
4 High Resolution (8 bits)
5 Very High Resolution (16 bits)
6 Ultra High Resolution (32 bits)

items.name: Video Octets & Video Cells Counters
items.comment: This Data Item contains the number of valid octets (i.e. non-empty octets) used in the coding of the video signal amplitude and the number of valid cells in the video group.

data_fields.name: NB_VB
data_fields.comment: Number of valid octets in the Video Block Data Volume Item (I240/050, I240/051 or I240/052)

data_fields.name: NB_CELLS
data_fields.comment: Number of valid cells in the Video Block Data Volume Item (I240/050, I240/051 or I240/052)

items.name: Video Block Low Data Volume
items.comment: Contains a group of video cells corresponding to a video radial; all cells have the same size in azimuth and range and are consecutive in range. Used for a low data volume, up to 1020 bytes.

items.name: VIDEO_BLOCK
items.comment: Video signal amplitude of the cells in the group, coded according to the resolution defined in I240/048

items.name: Video Block Medium Data Volume
items.comment: Contains a group of video cells corresponding to a video radial; all cells have the same size in azimuth and range and are consecutive in range. Used for a medium data volume, up to 16320 bytes.

items.name: VIDEO_BLOCK
items.comment: Video signal amplitude of the cells in the group, coded according to the resolution defined in I240/048

items.name: Video Block High Data Volume
items.comment: Contains a group of video cells corresponding to a video radial; all cells have the same size in azimuth and range and are consecutive in range. Used for a high data volume, up to 65024 bytes (REP at most 254).

items.name: VIDEO_BLOCK
items.comment: Video signal amplitude of the cells in the group, coded according to the resolution defined in I240/048

items.name: Time of Day
items.comment: Absolute time stamping expressed as UTC.

data_fields.name: Time of Day
data_fields.comment: Reset to zero each day at midnight
